support_spans: predominantly plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
nuclear hyperchromasia, pleomorphism, or atypicality was not seen, and mitoses were sparse
there was no necrosis or inflammatory cells
contradict_spans: clinical impression of lymphoreticular malignancy or metastatic disease

support_spans: seven subcutaneous, nontender, mobile swellings measuring 1×1 to 3×3 cm in the cervical regions, right paraspinal area, and anterior abdominal wall
cytology smears from all sites showed moderate cellularity with similar features: predominantly plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
contradict_spans: no significant past medical, personal, or family history
